Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic XL-MS (cross-linking mass spectrometry) study using the BS3 crosslinker to map the conformational ensemble of alpha-synuclein. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'Affinity purification', the methods text explicitly describes a cross-linking workflow using BS3 and trypsin digestion. The 'mod_tpp' modifier is the closest match for cross-linking/proximity-based structural proteomics in the provided modifier list.

scope: We follow the protocol introduced by Grupi & Haas for the expression and production of recombinant α-syn variants (WT and different single cysteine mutants V26C, Y39C or A56C).
We elute α-syn with a salt gradient from 0 to 500 mM NaCl.
The proteins were precipitated in 1 mL of acetone (℃⁻80 °C) for one hour, followed by by centrifugation at 14,000 g. The pellet was resuspended in 20 μL of 8 M urea.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry was performed on recombinant α-synuclein purified from E. coli using ion-exchange chromatography (MonoQ column) and subsequent precipitation/digestion. While PRIDE metadata mentions 'Affinity purification', the text describes a standard protein purification and cross-linking (XL-MS) workflow for a single recombinant protein, fitting 'purified protein or complex'.

evidence: We further confirm the generated conformational ensemble in orthogonal experiments utilizing far-UV circular dichroism and cross-linking mass spectrometry.
